baseline.evidence_rule: A specification, policy file, host application or host test does not prove native kernel behavior.

domains.title: Physical and virtual memory
domains.current_boundary: Boot Info v1 memory-map validation and a monotonic 4 KiB frame allocator allocate and clear one early frame. No reusable free path, page tables, heap or process address spaces.
domains.next_gate: Reusable physical allocator and owned x86_64 page-table manager with permissions, address spaces and TLB invalidation.
acceptance: QEMU page-fault and multi-CPU TLB shootdown tests

domains.title: GDT, TSS, IDT, interrupt controllers, timers and scheduler
domains.current_boundary: Main has a 256-entry IDT and fatal handlers for CPU exceptions 0–31. External IRQs are disabled; owned GDT/TSS/IST, APIC/IOAPIC, timer routing and context-switch scheduler are not implemented.
domains.next_gate: Owned GDT/TSS/IST, ACPI MADT, Local APIC/IOAPIC, timer source, SMP startup and preemptive scheduler.
acceptance: QEMU one-CPU and SMP interrupt/wakeup tests

domains.title: Processes, threads, Ring 3 and DABI64
domains.current_boundary: Reaper process, VM, IPC and scheduler policy modules exist; no native process creation, address-space switch, user-mode transition or syscall dispatcher is claimed.
domains.next_gate: ELF64 loader, per-process address spaces, Ring 3 entry, syscall entry and tested DABI64 v1 dispatcher.
acceptance: Syscall allow/deny and safe user-copy tests

domains.title: VFS, persistent filesystem and user profiles
domains.current_boundary: VFS/history/CRDT policy modules exist; there is no kernel-mounted persistent disk filesystem or reboot-persistent user session.
domains.next_gate: VFS and initramfs/tmpfs/devfs/procfs, then an ADR-selected crash-consistent persistent filesystem and profile service.

domains.title: ACPI, PCI/PCIe, USB and driver architecture
domains.current_boundary: Driver ABI and resource-conflict policies exist; no native ACPI/PCI/USB enumeration, DMA isolation or driver loading is claimed.
domains.next_gate: Bounded ACPI table parsing, PCIe enumeration, virtio device support and a capability-scoped driver lifecycle.

domains.title: Freestanding Reaper Runtime and native services
domains.current_boundary: Reaper reference and partial native host tooling are federated separately; DuckOS Reaper policy contracts are not a freestanding runtime or kernel syscall dispatcher.
domains.next_gate: Freestanding Reaper target, native ELF64/DABI64 output, kernel syscall adapter, PID 1 and supervised user services.
acceptance: Reaper service builds without hosted runtime

domains.title: Native Duck Desktop, compositor and window system
domains.current_boundary: Mora is a host-browser shell. Reaper desktop policies and host-native UI prototypes do not provide a kernel-launched compositor or native DuckOS session.
domains.next_gate: User-space framebuffer compositor, input service, window manager and native Reaper login/session.

domains.title: GPU, audio, network and power services
domains.current_boundary: Graphics/audio/network/platform Reaper modules are policy contracts, not GPU/audio/network drivers or power-management services.
domains.next_gate: Virtualized baseline drivers/services for virtio-gpu, virtio-snd, virtio-net, display input and ACPI power states.
acceptance: GPU reset and buffer ownership tests
Network disconnect/reconnect and malformed packet tests

domains.title: Jora Store, DuckBridge and BAV
domains.current_boundary: Package/catalogue, PE/ELF inspection, compatibility planning and BAV declarative contracts exist as host/policy foundations; no kernel-enforced package sandbox or endpoint scanner is claimed.
domains.next_gate: Signed offline package repository, transactional installer, isolated DuckBridge execution and sandboxed BAV scanning.
acceptance: BAV scan without executing inspected content

domains.title: Installer, Secure Boot, updates, recovery and rollback
domains.current_boundary: Release/deployment plans and archive/signature helpers exist, but the current ISO is not a disk installer, authenticated boot chain or A/B update system.
domains.next_gate: Explicit UEFI installer, signed boot artifacts, A/B slots, recovery image and boot-success rollback.
acceptance: BIOS/UEFI install into disposable QEMU disks
Boot rollback and user-data-preserving recovery tests
OVMF Secure Boot with controlled enrolled keys
